a-bough-for-the-fallen: Spend 2 SP and roll Reason to heal a creature within 3 squares and give it a chance to move toward you without provoking.
a-breath-beneath-the-water: Let up to four adjacent willing creatures breathe air and water for an hour.
a-camp-without-a-trace: Hide the traces of your camp in ten minutes and give your group 2 Boons to conceal its trail during the first hour of travel.
a-coal-for-a-promise: Make a Guile spell attack that burns an enemy within 5 squares and can leave it Frightened.
a-company-of-reflections: Give up to three willing creatures within 3 squares 2 Boons to defenses until the end of your next turn.
a-courtesy-unanswered: Make a Guile melee attack that can Slow your target. Gain 1 Boon if you started Hidden.
a-door-that-is-not-there: Create a silent image of a door, window, curtain or screen for ten minutes. Touch reveals the illusion.
a-friend-beneath-the-door: Summon a Novice Fey within 3 squares for one scene. Choose its form each time you cast.
a-good-place-to-stop: Examine a campsite for ten minutes to find its hazards and shelter. Use that shelter to give your group 1 Boon against weather and exposure.
a-hand-from-before: Use a Reaction to give a nearby ally 1 Boon against a physical attack. Afterward, it may move up to 2 squares to your side without provoking.
a-knot-you-can-trust: Secure or release a rope at an anchor as part of your climb.
a-line-for-everyone: Secure a rope route in ten minutes. Give your group 1 Boon to traverse it and climb the rope at normal movement cost.
a-lock-has-a-language: Roll Reason to open an ordinary lock and learn whether it was damaged or tampered with. You can relock it with a Maneuver.
a-marvel-on-wheels: Roll Knowledge to fire a folding launcher that damages and pushes creatures in a line of three squares.
a-party-piece: Choose an instrument you own when you learn this ability. Gain 1 Boon to Guile rolls while playing it.
a-place-at-any-fire: Talk with a nonhostile gathering for ten minutes to find a host who offers your party food, a bed and a useful local introduction.
a-ribcage-for-a-shield: Use a Reaction to give an ally 2 Boons against a physical attack, then push an attacker adjacent to that ally 2 squares away.
a-road-through-rain: Sweep smoke, fog, dust, rain and airborne poison from up to six connected squares. Sustain the clear air with a Maneuver each turn.
a-roof-before-nightfall: Learn Camp Shelter and roll Knowledge to build protection from rain and wind for your group.
a-shadow-at-the-heart: Make a Guile melee attack that can Daze your target. Gain 2 Boons if you started Hidden.
a-shelter-of-light: Give yourself and nearby willing allies 1 Boon to defenses. Sustain the shelter with a Maneuver each turn.
a-sign-against-harm: Use a Reaction to give yourself or a willing ally within 3 squares 1 Boon to a defense roll.
a-small-and-watchful-shape: Take the shape of a cat-sized land animal for ten minutes to slip through small openings and gain 1 Boon to Agility rolls to Hide.
a-splendid-mistake: Roll Guile to deal fire or lightning damage in a 3-by-3 area. Standard and Strong results also push creatures outward.
a-steady-hand-at-dawn: Complete treatment in one minute and improve its Weak healing.
a-sword-made-of-dawn: Make a Knowledge spell attack that deals fire damage and can push or ignite an enemy. Gain 2 Boons against a Burning target.
a-thought-that-is-not-yours: Make a Reason spell attack that deals mental damage and can Daze an enemy within 4 squares.
a-verse-for-courage: Let an ally who hears you move 1 square without provoking and give it 1 Boon to its next attribute roll.
a-voice-across-the-valley: Call a creature you know within a day's travel and speak with it for up to ten minutes if it answers.
a-word-apart: Whisper up to twenty words to an adjacent ally and give it 2 Boons on its next Guile or Reason roll for the social task you name.
aid: Use a Maneuver to help an adjacent ally and give it 1 Boon on its next roll for the task.
all-voices-as-one: Call willing allies within 4 squares to make free Basic Melee attacks. They gain 1 Boon against Frightened targets.
an-impossible-theft: Roll Guile to pull a small unattended, held or unsecured object toward you from up to 6 squares away.
an-invitation-elsewhere: Roll Guile to pull an enemy toward you. On Standard or Strong, you can also move 1 square without provoking.
anatomy-of-an-opening: Make a Knowledge melee attack that can reveal the target's physical resistance. On Strong, you can also move 1 square without provoking.
another-tongue: Learn one ordinary language when you take this ability, including its usual script if it has one.
answer-for-what-you-did: While wearing armor, use a Maneuver to stand and move up to 2 squares without provoking.
armored-recovery: Move toward an ally without provoking. If you end adjacent, you both gain 1 Boon to defenses while you stay together until the end of your next turn.
arrive-under-guard: Spend ten minutes and roll Reason to learn a danger on a course of action you propose. Better results reveal a way to lessen it or a warning sign.
ask-the-falling-ash: Use a Maneuver to reduce temporary Burning by 2 or put out an adjacent hand-sized flame.
basic-melee: Strike an adjacent creature with your melee weapon. Roll Brawn for 2/3/5 physical damage.
basic-ranged: Shoot a visible creature within 8 squares. Roll Agility for 2/3/5 physical damage.
basic-throw: Throw a suitable carried object at a visible creature within 3 squares. Roll Brawn for 2/3/5 physical damage.
basic-unarmed: Strike an adjacent creature with your bare hands or a kick. Roll Brawn for 1/2/4 physical damage.
behind-the-hawthorn: After an adjacent creature's melee attack against you resolves, roll Agility to push it away and knock it Prone on a Strong result.
bind-and-turn: Make a Fortitude melee attack against an adjacent creature for 3, 5 or 7 physical damage.
blood-in-the-teeth: Make a sound or speak up to twenty words from a point within 4 squares, using your own voice or one you've heard.
borrow-a-voice: Take the form of a land beast for the scene. Follow trails by scent with 1 Boon and attack with claws or teeth.
borrow-the-beast: Use a Reaction to move toward cover when a nearby creature passes it. If your destination conceals you, try to Hide with 1 Boon.
borrow-the-shadow: Roll Guile to spread smoke for heavy cover or ice for difficult terrain. Sustain the area with a Maneuver each turn.
borrow-tomorrow-s-weather: Prepare a disguise in ten minutes, learn a detail that sells the role and gain 1 Boon to Guile rolls to pass as that role.
borrowed-clothes-borrowed-manners: Prepare a cover identity for yourself and up to three companions. Each gains 2 Boons to Guile or Reason rolls to maintain it.
borrowed-identity: Use a Reaction to gain 2 Boons to defend against a visible attack, then move 1 square without provoking.
borrowed-silhouette: Learn Lesser Healing Bottle and Travel Food. Brew or refill a lesser bottle in one hour without a roll, or roll Knowledge to craft provisions.
bottled-morning: When your melee attack drops a creature to 0 HP, use a Reaction to move up to 3 squares without provoking and make a free Basic Melee attack against a different creature.
bow-to-the-balcony: While wearing armor, use a Reaction and roll Fortitude to gain Stability against incoming forced movement.
braced-harness: When an enemy moves adjacent, use a Reaction to strike with Fortitude and push it back the way it came.
break-the-charge: Make a Brawn melee attack that damages and pushes an adjacent creature. A Strong result also knocks it Prone.
break-the-formation: Use a Reaction to reduce an incoming Grappled contribution by 3, then move 1 square without provoking.
breath-of-the-wyrmling: Roll Knowledge to deal cold damage in three connected squares next to you. A Strong result also inflicts Freezing.
briar-gate: Create a bridge across a gap up to 3 squares wide for ten minutes.
bridge-of-winter: Summon a Novice Spirit within 3 squares for one scene. Choose its form each time you cast.
call-a-burrower: Summon a Spirit of Adept tier or lower within 3 squares for one scene.
call-a-sentinel: Summon an Elemental of Master tier or lower within 3 squares for one scene.
call-a-tempest-beast: Summon an Animal of Master tier or lower within 3 squares for one scene.
call-the-elder-stag: Summon a Novice Animal within 3 squares for one scene. Choose its form each time you cast.
call-the-faithful-hound: Summon an Animal of Adept tier or lower within 3 squares for one scene.
call-the-hunting-cat: Give up to three willing creatures 1 Boon to attack and defense rolls. Sustain the blessing with a Maneuver each turn.
call-the-opening: Use a Reaction to reduce an ally's temporary Frightened by 1 before it rolls with the penalty.
carry-the-sunrise: Swim up to your Speed while supporting up to two adjacent companions. This movement costs 1 per square and does not provoke.
carry-them-to-shore: Use a Maneuver to carry or support an adjacent willing or unconscious ally and move up to your Speed without provoking.
carry-to-safety: Use a Maneuver to reduce temporary Poisoned by 3 on willing living creatures within 3 squares, including yourself.
cast-through-the-reflection: Carry one adjacent willing creature or a creature at 0 HP at half your Speed, keeping it beside you.
catch-a-falling-friend: Use a Reaction to catch a falling unattended object that fits in your free hand.
catch-that: Use a Reaction and a free hand to catch a reachable ledge or hold when you start falling.
catch-the-spell: Before defending against a single-target spell from a visible caster within 4 squares, gain 2 Boons to the defense. On a Strong defense, after the spell resolves, move up to 2 squares without provoking.
checkmate-in-three-steps: Choose one adjacent enemy. Make a Knowledge melee attack. Against a Slowed target, gain 1 Boon to this attack. On a Standard result, deal 5 physical damage. Push 1 square and apply Prone.
cinder-cast: Choose one visible enemy within 5 squares. Make a Knowledge spell attack. Weak — 3 fire damage. Standard — 3 fire damage and Burning 1. Strong — 5 fire damage and Burning 2.
circle-of-old-names: Self and willing allies within 2 squares. Each recipient reduces temporary Frightened by 1 and gains Stability 2 until the end of your next turn.
command-a-summon: Command a summon within 6 squares. Spend a Main Action to give it a Main Action and Maneuver, or a Maneuver to give it a Maneuver and movement.
conditioned-body: Maximum HP +1 per purchase. Purchase once at each character level. Each level's purchase stands on its own. This ability increases maximum HP only.
convert-an-action: Spend Main Action to gain a Maneuver. Spend a Maneuver to gain another movement allowance. One-way conversion only. Converting both gives a full sprint.
create-a-distraction: Choose one creature within 3 squares that sees or hears your distraction. Make a Guile roll. Choose an ally within 3 squares who sees or hears your cue. Its next attack against the target or roll moving past it unnoticed before the end of your next turn gains 1/2/2 Boons on Weak/Standard/Strong. On Strong, a second such ally gains 1 Boon to its next qualifying roll.
cut-off-the-escape: Choose one visible enemy within 8 squares. Make an Agility ranged attack. On a Standard result, deal 4 physical damage and Slowed 1. Push 1 square away from you.
dance-beyond-the-circle: Two visible willing creatures within 6 squares, either of which may be yourself. Exchange the two creatures' positions by teleportation. Each destination must fit its new occupant. Each gains 1 Boon to its next defense before the end of your next turn.
dawn-shard: Choose one visible enemy within 5 squares. Make a Reason spell attack. On a Standard result, deal 3 radiant damage. Outline the target in light until the end of your next turn. The next attack against it before then gains 1 Boon.
defend: Gain 1 Boon to defense rolls. Repeating this same benefit does not increase it. Shield Block is a separate source and stacks through Boon/Bane rules.
derive-a-mechanism: Choose one accessible ordinary mechanical item. Study the item and write an ordinary recipe for its mechanism. Before work begins, the DA states the recipe's output, required materials and tools, full crafting interval and the crafting capability that can use it. After four hours of study, you learn that recipe.
disengage: Your voluntary movement does not provoke opportunity attacks for the rest of this turn.
drain-warmth: Choose one visible enemy within 4 squares. Make a Guile spell attack. Weak — 2 Life damage. Standard — 3 Life damage. Strong — 5 Life damage and Slowed 1.
draw-the-current: Self and one creature damaged by your next qualifying spell this turn. Prepare your next damaging Main Action spell this turn. After it resolves, choose one visible creature it damaged within 6 squares. Push or pull that creature 2 squares away from or toward you.
dread-reflection: Choose one visible enemy within 5 squares. Make a Guile spell attack. You are the source of Frightened. On a Standard result, deal 3 mental damage and Frightened 1.
driving-volley: Choose up to two visible enemies within 8 squares. Make an Agility ranged attack against the chosen targets. On a Standard result, deal 3 physical damage. Push 1 square away from you.
ember-along-the-edge: Choose one adjacent enemy. Make a Knowledge weapon spell attack. On a Standard result, deal 2 physical and 2 fire damage and Burning 1.
enchanting-workshop: Choose one known compatible special-item or ordinary recipe. Choose one special-item recipe available in the campaign and two ordinary recipes chosen from Bound Torches, Fletched Ammunition, Travel Food, Twisted Cord, Wooden Brace and Simple Replacement Leg. Learn them. You can craft known special-item recipes and the compatible ordinary recipes using their stated materials, tools and full intervals. Roll Knowledge: Weak adds 1 progress, Standard 2, Strong 3, or the recipe's inventory steps for a supply.
expert-river-crossing: Self and one adjacent willing companion during a shared swim. You and one adjacent willing companion you guide gain 1 Boon to attribute rolls completing the same swim. You may keep one carried item of Bulk 1 or less dry during that swim.
fit-a-replacement: Choose one willing patient and a suitable already-made, correctly sized prosthesis. Fit and adjust the prosthesis to its patient. At the end of the work, it restores the ordinary support or grip described by its recipe. A descriptive scar never requires a prosthesis.
forage-coast: Choose one viable shore. Choose one food or ordinary material supply for which the area contains usable resources. Make a Knowledge roll and raise that supply by 1/2/3 inventory steps on Weak/Standard/Strong, up to d8. The first step from out creates d4. The DA identifies which resources the patch can actually provide and when it is exhausted.
forage-mountains: Choose one viable mountain patch. Choose one food or ordinary material supply for which the area contains usable resources. Make a Knowledge roll and raise that supply by 1/2/3 inventory steps on Weak/Standard/Strong, up to d8. The first step from out creates d4. The DA identifies which resources the patch can actually provide and when it is exhausted.
forage-wetlands: Choose one viable marsh or riverside patch. Choose one food or ordinary material supply for which the area contains usable resources. Make a Knowledge roll and raise that supply by 1/2/3 inventory steps on Weak/Standard/Strong, up to d8. The first step from out creates d4. The DA identifies which resources the patch can actually provide and when it is exhausted.
forage-woodland: Choose one viable natural area. Choose one food or ordinary material supply for which the area contains usable resources. Make a Knowledge roll and raise that supply by 1/2/3 inventory steps on Weak/Standard/Strong, up to d8. The first step from out creates d4. The DA identifies which resources the patch can actually provide and when it is exhausted.
force: Roll Brawn to add 1/2/3 obstacle progress, reduce your Grappled rating by 1/2/3, or push a creature 1/2/3 squares.
forked-sky: Choose up to three visible enemies within 6 squares. Make a Knowledge spell attack against the chosen targets. On a Standard result, deal 4 lightning damage and Burning 1.
four-winds-at-once: Every other adjacent creature. Make a Fortitude area attack. On a Standard result, deal 4 physical damage. Push 2 squares away from you.
furnace-sweep: Every creature in a 3-wide, 2-deep rectangle immediately ahead of you. Make a Knowledge area spell attack. On a Standard result, deal 3 fire damage. Push 1 square away from you.
guide-a-frightened-animal: Choose one animal within 3 squares that sees or hears you. Make a Guile roll. Learn the animal's immediate source of distress and one approach it would presently accept, such as an offered lead, food or a familiar handler. On a Standard result, reduce its temporary Frightened by 2.
guide-the-crossing: Self and up to six companions crossing one natural hazard outside combat. Prepare a physically possible route across one natural hazard using the supports and equipment your party can supply. After ten minutes, you and up to six companions complete that crossing together. You may include companions carried by the group. Before preparation begins, the DA tells you the equipment and carrying capacity the route needs.
gust-hammer: Choose one visible enemy within 4 squares. Make a Reason spell attack. On a Standard result, deal 2 physical damage. Push 2 squares away from you.
handle-an-item: Choose an accessible item. Drawing a weapon is included in its attack action. Dropping is free. Proper stowing or picking up costs a Maneuver. Ordinary item use follows its own card. No free two-handed grip exception is assumed.
haul-them-home: Choose one willing or unconscious creature within 5 squares, already secured to a rope you hold, whose weight you can support. Move the recipient up to 3 squares toward you along the clear rope-supported route, including upward. This rescue movement ignores Stability and does not provoke. A Grappled recipient can join once its hold has been released.
hold-a-conversation: Choose one nonhostile creature you share a language with. Choose one plausible conversation objective. Make a Guile check to make progress toward the social task. On a Standard result, add 3 progress.
hold-the-passage: Self and willing adjacent allies. You and willing adjacent allies gain 1 Boon to defenses and Stability 1 until the end of your next turn while adjacent to you and while you hold the shield.
hook-and-drive: Choose one adjacent creature. Make a Brawn melee attack. On a Standard result, deal 3 physical damage and Slowed 2.
hurl-aside: Choose one adjacent enemy and every other Prone enemy adjacent to you. Make a Brawn melee attack. Apply the result to each target. On a Standard result, deal 5 physical damage. Push it 3 squares directly away from you and apply Prone.
i-have-seen-this-step: Choose one willing ally within 3 squares who hears you, before it defends against a visible physical attack. The ally gains 1 Boon to the defense. After the attack resolves, it may move 1 square without provoking.
ice-across-the-break: Choose one visible straight gap up to 5 squares wide within 5 squares, with same-height anchors at both ends. Create a one-square-wide supported bridge across up to 5 straight empty squares between same-height solid anchors. The bridge costs 1 movement per square for everyone and lasts ten minutes. It warns occupants in its final minute and remains beneath current travelers until they reach an anchor. You may replace it when those travelers are secure.
icebound-path: Visible unoccupied ground squares within 5 squares, joined along their edges. Make a Knowledge roll and cover up to 3/5/7 connected squares on Weak/Standard/Strong with ice. The area is difficult terrain until the end of your next turn. The first time an enemy enters one of its squares during a turn, it gains Slowed 1. On later turns, you may spend a Maneuver to sustain the area until the end of your next turn.
identify-a-mixture: Choose one accessible potion or mixture. Examine the mixture and make a Reason roll. The mixture remains available afterward. On a Standard result, learn its effects, use and any contamination or harmful additive.
identify-an-enchantment: Choose one accessible magical item. Study the item and make a Knowledge roll. On a Standard result, learn its functions, activation requirements and the triggers of any curse.
intrusive-echo: Choose one visible enemy within 4 squares. Make a Guile spell attack. Against a Deafened target, gain 1 Boon to this attack. On a Standard result, deal 2 mental damage and Dazed 1.
invitation-to-the-blade: Choose one adjacent creature. Make an Agility melee attack. On a Standard result, deal 4 physical damage. Gain 1 Boon to your next defense against this target before the start of your next turn.
keep-time-with-steel: Choose one adjacent enemy. One willing ally within 3 squares who hears you. Make a Guile melee attack. On a Standard result, deal 3 physical damage. The ally may move 2 squares without provoking.
keep-your-bearings: Choose a navigation task in an unfamiliar place with usable landmarks. Make a navigation check to make progress toward the navigation task. On a Standard result, add 2 progress.
lantern-in-the-palm: Self and squares within 3 squares. Create a light that hovers at your shoulder for the scene and illuminates squares within 3 squares along unobstructed paths. You may end it freely or replace it with a new casting.
lantern-moths: Choose up to three visible unoccupied squares within 4 squares. Create up to three lights for the scene. Each illuminates its square and adjacent squares. With a Maneuver, move each light up to 2 squares along an open route, keeping it within 6 squares of you. You can end any of your lights freely. Recasting replaces your previous lights.
let-the-spark-decide: Choose fire or cold, then make a Guile spell attack against a visible enemy within 5 squares. The attack deals damage of that type and can push the enemy away.
live-in-the-mask: While maintaining a plausible mundane disguise or impersonation, gain 2 Boons to Guile or Reason rolls maintaining a plausible mundane disguise or impersonation during conversation.
look-over-here: Choose one ally about to make a defense roll against a sight-dependent attack declared by an adjacent enemy that can see you. Before the roll. Grant the ally 1 Boon to that defense roll. The distraction affects the defense roll. The attack resolves normally. Apply the normal Boon/Bane rules.
make-something-useful: Choose one known compatible ordinary recipe and suitable salvaged materials. Learn two recipes chosen from Bound Torches, Fletched Ammunition, Travel Food, Twisted Cord, Wooden Brace and Simple Replacement Leg. You can craft those and other known recipes explicitly compatible with this ability, using equivalent salvaged materials the DA confirms are suitable. Roll Knowledge: Weak adds 1 progress or inventory step, Standard 2, Strong 3, as the recipe specifies.
measured-appeal: Choose one willing negotiating partner who can understand you. Make a Guile roll toward the concession you seek. On a Standard result, add 3 progress. Learn a counteroffer the listener would accept.
mercy-in-the-light: Choose one visible willing creature within 3 squares, including yourself, or one creature in range harmed by healing. Pay 1 SP and make a Reason healing roll. On a Standard result, restore 5 HP and reduce temporary Frightened by 1.
message-by-heart: Choose one message of up to 50 words that you can hear, or read in a script you know. After rehearsing the message for one minute, you can reproduce its words exactly from memory. You may retain unfamiliar words this way without understanding them. You can retain one message at a time. Memorizing another replaces it. Recalling the stored message takes only the normal time to speak or write it. Translation and understanding come from your own knowledge or other abilities.
move: Spend up to Speed in movement squares, split around your actions. Normal terrain costs 1. Difficult terrain costs 2. Occupied squares cannot be crossed unless the occupant is prone. Crossing costs 2 and cannot end there.
name-the-reckoning: Choose one enemy within 4 squares who hears and understands you. Make a Guile control attack. You are the source of the Frightened condition. On a Standard result, frightened 2.
no-footfall-at-all: Your movement makes no audible footfalls. As a Maneuver, move up to your Speed without provoking.
no-road-away: Choose a visible enemy within 3 squares when it begins voluntary movement. You and one willing ally within 3 squares who hears you. After the enemy finishes moving, you and the ally may each move up to 3 squares toward it without provoking.
noonday-judgment: Every creature in one visible 3-by-3 area within 6 squares. Make a Reason area spell attack. On a Standard result, deal 4 radiant damage and Blinded 1.
not-yet-your-name: Choose one adjacent willing or unconscious creature after it enters Dying. Pay 4 SP and restore 12 HP to the recipient.
notice-the-human-detail: Choose an investigation task about a social gathering or group you can observe. Make an investigation check to make progress toward the investigation task. On a Standard result, add 2 progress.
oathlight-strike: Choose one adjacent enemy. Make a Reason melee attack. On a Standard result, deal 2 physical and 1 radiant damage. One willing ally within 2 squares gains 1 Boon to its next defense before the end of your next turn.
one-more-dawn: Gain a Boon to Fortitude death rolls.
open-the-furnace-door: Every creature in a 3-wide, 2-deep rectangle immediately ahead of you. Make a Guile area spell attack. You are the source of its Frightened condition. On a Standard result, deal 5 fire damage. Push 2 squares away from you.
opportunity-attack: When an adjacent creature provokes, spend your Reaction to use Basic Melee with a held melee weapon or Basic Unarmed with a free hand.
ordinary-recipe-study: Two new compatible ordinary recipes. Learn two new ordinary recipes compatible with a crafting ability you know.
pack-with-purpose: Your own carried inventory. Once on your turn, stow one held ordinary item as part of drawing a different stowed weapon for an attack. The weapon still needs the required hands. The benefit covers the stow-and-draw. Potions, inventory space and Bulk follow their normal rules.
palm-of-the-gale: Choose one adjacent enemy. Make a Fortitude melee spell attack. On a Standard result, deal 3 physical damage. Push 2 squares away from you.
pinning-shot: Choose one visible enemy within 8 squares. Make an Agility ranged attack. Weak — 3 physical damage. Standard — 3 physical damage and Slowed 1. Strong — 5 physical damage and Slowed 2.
pounce-of-the-red-claw: Choose one enemy reachable by a legal move of up to 3 squares. Move up to 3 squares without provoking, then make an Agility unarmed attack against an adjacent enemy. On a Standard result, deal 5 physical damage and Prone.
procession-of-the-quiet: Choose one visible unoccupied placement within 3 squares that fits the chosen form's entire footprint. Choose one Undead entry from the summon selection with a minimum tier of 7 or lower. Call one instance using its summon profile. Choose the form anew each casting. It remains for one scene.
quick-exit: When you use disengage, gain 1 additional square of available movement this turn. Spend it using normal terrain costs and movement restrictions. The bonus applies to the Disengage movement. Your Speed and converted movement allowances stay unchanged. Disengage's protection from opportunity attacks applies normally.
quiet-latch: Pick an adjacent ordinary lock with a Guile roll. Your toolwork is audible only in adjacent squares.
read-a-dangerous-trail: Choose one accessible physical trail. Read the tracks and make a Reason roll. On a Standard result, also learn the most recent danger their trail shows they encountered, and where they encountered it.
read-the-maker-s-hand: Choose one accessible ordinary mechanism. Learn the mechanism's ordinary materials, intended function and one accessible component whose removal or adjustment would disable it. Choose a component suitable for reuse in a known compatible recipe, if one is present. You or an ally gains 2 Boons to the next attribute roll this scene repairing or disabling the mechanism, or crafting with that component.
read-the-next-blow: Before defending against a visible physical attack, use Reason for this defense and gain 1 Boon to it.
read-the-quarry: Choose one visible enemy within 8 squares. Make a Knowledge ranged attack. Learn a distinctive trace useful for following the target and gain 1 Boon to rolls following its physical trail for the scene. On a Standard result, deal 3 physical damage.
read-the-remains: Choose one accessible scene or evidence-bearing object. Choose a question about what happened here and make a Reason roll. The DA answers from the surviving evidence. On a Standard result, also learn which part of that account remains uncertain and where you could investigate it.
reconstruct-the-event: Choose one accessible scene with physical evidence of an event. Choose an event that left physical traces in the scene. The DA describes its evidence-supported sequence, identifies where the evidence leaves a gap, and names one specific place, person or object to investigate that gap, if a lead survives. You can show the reconstruction to your companions as a shared ghostly image of the supported sequence.
reduce-a-condition: Self or one adjacent creature. With a plausible method, reduce Bleeding, Burning, or Freezing by 1. This is not a general cure for all conditions. A persistent source can require a specific remedy.
relieve-poison: Self or one adjacent willing creature. Make a Knowledge roll. Weak — Reduce temporary Poisoned by 1. Standard — Reduce temporary Poisoned by 2. Strong — Reduce temporary Poisoned by 3.
remember-this-name: Choose a specific deed or act people credit to you, whether true or rumored, and a name by which you are known, such as Eric the Red or Torag Silver Tongue. Record a recognizable description associated with that reputation. Your name, reputation and the description people associate with you become established facts of the campaign. Wherever your reputation is known, its stories carry that description. When your reputation helps a roll, gain 2 Boons. When it hinders a roll, take 2 Banes.
rest-for-the-restless: Choose one visible enemy within 4 squares. Make a Reason spell attack. On a Standard result, deal 4 Life damage.
return-to-strength: Choose one willing creature within 3 squares, including yourself, or one creature in range harmed by healing. Pay 4 SP and make a Reason healing roll. On a Standard result, restore 16 HP.
reveal-the-threshold: Choose one visible 3-by-3 area within 5 squares. Make a Reason roll while examining the area. On a Standard result, also reveal how it is activated or sustained.
ride-the-falling-stone: When a floor, ledge or support gives way beneath you, before the fall, make an Agility roll and move across the collapsing support without provoking. On a Standard result, move up to 3 squares.
rime-grip: Choose one visible enemy within 5 squares. Make a Knowledge spell attack. On a Standard result, deal 3 cold damage and Slowed 1.
roots-remember-feet: Choose one visible grounded enemy within 4 squares. Make a Reason control attack. On a Standard result, deal 2 physical damage, Slowed 2. Pull 1 square toward you.
rouse-the-senses: Choose one adjacent willing creature. Make a Reason roll. Weak — Reduce temporary Dazed by 1. Standard — Reduce temporary Dazed by 2. Strong — Reduce temporary Dazed by 3.
running-vault: Self to a visible free supported landing within 5 squares. Jump up to 5 squares to a visible free supported landing, with no approach required. This movement does not provoke.
saddle-and-rein: While riding a willing mount, while riding a willing mount, gain 1 Boon to attribute rolls guiding it through difficult ground, keeping your seat or calming it. When an effect would make you fall from that mount, you may spend your Reaction to remain mounted.
sap-and-breath: Choose one willing creature within 2 squares, including yourself, or one creature in range harmed by healing. Pay 1 SP and make a Reason healing roll. On a Standard result, restore 5 HP and reduce temporary Bleeding by 1.
scales-beneath-the-skin: Before one event deals physical or fire damage, gain physical resistance 3 and fire resistance 3 against the event.
secure-a-hold: Choose one adjacent enemy. Make a Brawn grappling attack. Weak — Apply Grappled 1. Standard — Apply Grappled 2. Strong — Apply Grappled 3.
sell-the-feint: Choose one adjacent enemy that can see you. Gain 2 Boons to your next melee attack against the target this turn.
sever-the-pursuit: Choose up to three visible enemies within 8 squares. Make an Agility ranged attack against the chosen targets. On a Standard result, deal 4 physical damage and Slowed 2.
shared-breath: Choose one willing creature within 3 squares, including yourself, or one creature in range harmed by healing. Pay 1 SP and make a Reason healing roll. On a Standard result, restore 6 HP.
shield-block: Before the roll for a blockable attack, spend your Reaction. With a held shield, gain 1 Boon to blockable defenses or apply 1 Bane to the attacker’s roll until your next turn starts.
shielding-step: Choose one adjacent willing ally after a single-target attack is declared and before its roll. Replace the ally as the target if you meet the attack's range and targeting requirements. Resolve the attack against you.
silence-the-alarm: Choose one adjacent enemy. Make an Agility melee attack. On a Standard result, deal 4 physical damage. Suppress the target's speech until the end of its next turn.
smile-before-steel: Choose one adjacent creature. Make a Guile melee attack. On a Standard result, deal 4 physical damage, then move up to 1 square without provoking.
smoke-in-a-bottle: Choose one connected smoke area within 3 squares, or one compatible recipe while crafting. Use a prepared Smoke Flask supply and make a Knowledge roll. Fill up to 3/5/7 connected visible unoccupied ground squares within 3 squares with smoke on Weak/Standard/Strong. The smoke supplies heavy cover until the end of your next turn.
smoke-through-the-keyhole: Self through a continuous open gap to a visible free square within 2 squares. Become smoke and move with your carried equipment through a continuous open gap as narrow as a keyhole to a visible free square within 2 squares. This movement does not provoke. Reform at the destination.
speak-with-the-hearth: Choose one ordinary fire within reach. Read the fire's impressions of the previous day and make a Knowledge roll. Your touch is safe for this reading. On a Standard result, also see the appearance of its most recent visitor.
spring-in-the-sleeve: Choose one visible enemy within 3 squares. Make a Knowledge device attack. On a Standard result, deal 3 physical damage. Pull 1 square toward you.
stabilize: Stabilize an adjacent Dying hero at 0 HP and clear both death roll tallies. They regain consciousness from HP loss and can speak while waiting for healing.
stand: While prone, spend 2 squares of movement to stand. This spends movement, not a Maneuver.
step-between-lanterns: Self along a concealed route. Move up to 3 squares through actual dimness or concealment without provoking. Gain 1 Boon to any Agility roll needed to remain Hidden during this movement.
step-through-the-spark: Choose one visible free supported square within 3 squares. Teleport to the chosen square.
still-the-will: Choose one visible enemy within 4 squares. Make a Guile control attack. Weak — Slowed 1. Standard — Slowed 2. Strong — Slowed 3 and Dazed 1.
stillness-at-the-center: Choose one adjacent enemy and every other adjacent Grappled enemy. Choose one adjacent enemy and every other adjacent Grappled enemy. Make a Reason unarmed attack. On a Standard result, deal 4 physical damage, Slowed 1 and Dazed 1.
stitch-the-living-pattern: Choose one visible willing creature within 3 squares, including yourself, or one creature within that range harmed by healing. Pay 1 SP and make a Knowledge healing roll. On a Standard result, restore 5 HP.
stone-on-your-shoulders: Before one event deals physical damage, gain physical resistance 3 against the event. After it resolves, move 1 square without provoking.
storm-on-a-string: Choose one visible unattended object of Bulk 1 orless within 5 squares. Move the object up to 5 squares toward you along an open path. Catch it if it reaches your free hand, or leave it in the last square reached.
stride-of-the-giant: Every other adjacent creature. Make a Brawn area attack. On a Standard result, deal 4 physical damage. Push 2 squares away from you.
summon-construct-master: Choose one visible unoccupied placement within 3 squares that fits the chosen form's entire footprint. Choose one Construct entry from the summon selection with a minimum tier of 7 or lower. Call one instance using its summon profile. Choose the form anew each casting. It remains for one scene.
summon-construct-novice: Choose one visible unoccupied placement within 3 squares that fits the chosen form's entire footprint. Choose one Construct entry from the summon selection with a minimum tier of 1 or lower. Call one instance using its summon profile. Choose the form anew each casting. It remains for one scene.
summon-elemental-adept: Choose one visible unoccupied placement within 3 squares that fits the chosen form's entire footprint. Choose one Elemental entry from the summon selection with a minimum tier of 3 or lower. Call one instance using its summon profile. Choose the form anew each casting. It remains for one scene.
summon-elemental-novice: Choose one visible unoccupied placement within 3 squares that fits the chosen form's entire footprint. Choose one Elemental entry from the summon selection with a minimum tier of 1 or lower. Call one instance using its summon profile. Choose the form anew each casting. It remains for one scene.
summon-fey-adept: Choose one visible unoccupied placement within 3 squares that fits the chosen form's entire footprint. Choose one Fey entry from the summon selection with a minimum tier of 3 or lower. Call one instance using its summon profile. Choose the form anew each casting. It remains for one scene.
summon-fey-master: Choose one visible unoccupied placement within 3 squares that fits the chosen form's entire footprint. Choose one Fey entry from the summon selection with a minimum tier of 7 or lower. Call one instance using its summon profile. Choose the form anew each casting. It remains for one scene.
summon-undead-adept: Choose one visible unoccupied placement within 3 squares that fits the chosen form's entire footprint. Choose one Undead entry from the summon selection with a minimum tier of 3 or lower. Call one instance using its summon profile. Choose the form anew each casting. It remains for one scene.
sure-ascent: Self during a climb. Climbing costs you 1 movement per square. When you climb using a secured safety rope, gain 1 Boon to attribute rolls for that climb.
sustain-the-failing: Choose one willing creature within 3 squares, including yourself, or one creature in range harmed by healing. Pay 2 SP and make a Reason healing roll. On a Standard result, restore 10 HP.
swing-into-trouble: Choose a secured rope or hanging fixture and a visible free supported landing within 4 squares. Make an Agility roll and swing from the secured support. On a Standard result, move up to 3 squares. Push one enemy adjacent to the landing 1 square away from you.
take-the-measure: Choose one visible creature within your ranged attack's range. While you hold your position, your next ranged attack against the target this turn gains 1 Boon.
take-them-alive: Choose a creature reduced to 0 HP by your melee attack. Before making a melee attack, declare that you intend to capture the target. If it reduces an NPC to 0 HP, the NPC becomes Unconscious until the scene ends or it receives healing. This finishing blow leaves it alive and inflicts no wound.
teach-stone-to-bend: Ordinary stone in one adjacent square. Reshape up to one square of ordinary stone that you touch into a passage, handholds, steps or cover. The changed stone stays within that square and retains its new shape. Before you begin, the DA tells you whether the change will remove structural support.
tell-a-worthy-story: Choose a manipulation task involving one listener or a small audience that can understand you. Choose a claim you want the listener to accept: a lie, a cover story, a rumor, or a version of events that favors you. Make a manipulation check to make progress toward the manipulation task. On a Standard result, add 2 progress.
terms-before-swords: Choose a group of Frightened NPC enemies within 6 squares who hear and understand you. Offer safety in exchange for surrender. Make a Guile roll toward the group's surrender task. On a Standard result, add 5 progress.
the-ancestors-stand: Choose one visible unoccupied placement within 3 squares that fits the chosen form's entire footprint. Choose one Spirit entry from the summon selection with a minimum tier of 7 or lower. Call one instance using its summon profile. Choose the form anew each casting. It remains for one scene.
the-angle-of-unease: Choose one visible enemy within 5 squares. Make a Reason spell attack. You are the source of Frightened. On a Standard result, deal 3 mental damage. Push 2 squares away from you.
the-bones-rise: Choose one visible unoccupied placement within 3 squares that fits the chosen form's entire footprint. Choose one Undead entry from the summon selection with a minimum tier of 1 or lower. Call one instance using its summon profile. Choose the form anew each casting. It remains for one scene.
the-chorus-advances: Every willing ally within 3 squares who hears you. Each ally reduces temporary Frightened by 1 and may move up to 2 squares toward you without provoking.
the-circle-holds: Ground within 2 squares of your position when cast. Mark a circle of ground within 2 squares of your position. Until the end of your next turn, willing creatures in the circle gain 1 Boon to defenses against spells and Stability 2. On later turns, you may spend a Maneuver to sustain the circle until the end of your next turn.
the-city-opens-its-doors: Choose one inhabited city block you can examine. Name a place within 6 squares in the examined block that you want to reach. You and the DA establish a previously unmentioned concealed service entrance, roof path or passage from your current public location toward that place, consistent with the building's structure and established facts. The DA describes its entrance, exit and any obstacle along it. The route becomes an established feature your party can use.
the-cleverest-mixture: Self or up to two adjacent willing or unconscious creatures. On a Standard result, reduce Poisoned by 3 or Dazed by 2.
the-debt-comes-due: Choose one visible creature within 4 squares immediately after it damages you. Make a Guile spell attack against the creature. On a Standard result, deal 3 fire damage.
the-grove-gives-back: Choose up to three visible willing creatures within 3 squares, including yourself, or creatures in range harmed by healing. Pay 4 SP once and make a Reason healing roll. Divide the pool among the chosen recipients, assigning at least 1 HP to each. On a Standard result, share 20 HP, allocating up to 12 HP per recipient.
the-hunt-ends-here: Choose one visible enemy within 8 squares after it moves voluntarily. Make a Knowledge ranged attack. On a Standard result, deal 5 physical damage and Slowed 1.
the-key-changes-hands: Choose one adjacent visible Bulk 0 or 1 object that is unattended or unsecured in a pocket or pouch. Make a Guile roll and take the object into a free hand. On a Standard result, take it without immediate notice.
the-land-keeps-no-secrets: Choose a natural landscape visible from a vantage point. Examine the visible natural landscape. Name a destination you can see or a feature you seek, such as drinkable water, shelter or a pass. Learn the best available route toward it within the examined landscape and the terrain hazards on that route. You and up to six companions gain 2 Boons to attribute rolls negotiating those hazards while following the route.
the-moment-foretold: Choose one willing ally within 3 squares who hears you, after it rolls a Weak attribute result and before that result resolves. The ally rerolls the attribute roll with 2 Boons and uses the new result.
the-orchard-wakes: Choose one visible grounded enemy within 5 squares, plus every other visible grounded Slowed enemy within 5 squares. Choose one visible grounded enemy within 5 squares and every other visible grounded Slowed enemy within 5 squares. Make a Reason control attack. On a Standard result, pull each target 2 squares toward you and apply Slowed 2.
the-otter-s-bargain: For the scene, swimming costs you 1 movement per square and you gain 1 Boon to attribute rolls swimming against currents or keeping your course in rough water.
the-patient-metal: Choose one accessible damaged component of an ordinary metal item, small enough to hold between your hands. Reshape a damaged fitting, fastener, edge or link that fits between your hands. Make a Knowledge roll. On a Standard result, restore its ordinary function permanently.
the-right-small-courtesy: Choose a gathering you can observe. Learn a courtesy practiced by this gathering and whom it is appropriate to address first. When you use that courtesy, gain 1 Boon to Guile social rolls with members of the gathering for the rest of the scene.
the-road-remembers: Choose one physical trail you can touch. Choose one creature whose physical trail you can touch. You sense its passage along that trail during the previous day, learning its appearance, direction and whether it was traveling freely, fleeing or being carried. You can follow its faint footprints for the next hour while a continuous physical trail remains.
the-shape-of-escape: Self and one willing adjacent ally. You and one willing adjacent ally, with carried equipment, become ribbons of clay and move up to 4 squares along continuous open routes to visible free squares. Each route may pass through gaps as narrow as a finger. This movement does not provoke. Each traveler reforms at its destination.
the-sky-comes-down: Every creature in one visible 3-by-3 area within 6 squares. Make a Reason area spell attack. On a Standard result, deal 4 lightning damage. Push each target 1 square away from the center.
the-tale-will-tell-of-you: Help an ally who spends Grit stand and move to safety.
the-unlit-road: Your shadowed square and one visible free supported shadowed square within 4 squares. Teleport to the chosen shadowed square.
the-untroubled-hand: Choose one adjacent enemy. Make a Reason unarmed attack. On a Standard result, deal 3 physical damage. Push 1 square away from you.
the-walking-toolbox: Choose one visible unoccupied placement within 3 squares that fits the chosen form's entire footprint. Choose one Construct entry from the summon selection with a minimum tier of 3 or lower. Call one instance using its summon profile. Choose the form anew each casting. It remains for one scene.
the-wind-makes-room: Choose up to three visible willing creatures within 4 squares, including yourself. Each recipient may move up to 2 squares without provoking. Difficult terrain costs 1 movement per square for this move.
through-the-spearpoints: Move up to your Speed toward a visible enemy without provoking. End closer to that enemy. This movement is in addition to your ordinary movement.
thunder-at-the-door: Choose one visible enemy within 4 squares. Make a Reason spell attack. On a Standard result, deal 3 physical damage and Deafened 1.
thunder-ring: Every other creature within 1 square of you. Make a Reason area spell attack. On a Standard result, deal 3 physical damage. Push 1 square away from you.
trail-workshop: Choose one known compatible ordinary recipe. Learn two recipes chosen from Bound Torches, Fletched Ammunition, Travel Food, Twisted Cord, Wooden Brace and Simple Replacement Leg. You can craft those and other known recipes explicitly compatible with this ability. Roll Knowledge: Weak adds 1 progress or inventory step, Standard 2, Strong 3, as the recipe specifies.
translate-the-fragment: Choose one accessible page of unfamiliar writing or an inscription of similar length. Translate up to one page of unfamiliar writing, including an ancient or uncommon language, into a language you know. Preserve damaged or missing passages as gaps. You can read the translation aloud and make a copy for your companions.
traverse-the-impossible: Self to a visible free supported landing within 8 squares. Leap up to 8 squares to a visible free supported landing, clearing creatures and obstacles up to 2 squares high along the route. This movement does not provoke.
treat-bone: Improve a supplied treatment attempt to heal 3/5/7 HP, with a condition benefit on Strong.
treat-elemental-injury: Improve a supplied treatment attempt to heal 3/5/7 HP, with a condition benefit on Strong.
treat-life-injury: Improve a supplied treatment attempt to heal 3/5/7 HP, with a condition benefit on Strong.
treat-mental-trauma: Improve a supplied treatment attempt to heal 3/5/7 HP, with a condition benefit on Strong.
treat-radiant-injury: Improve a supplied treatment attempt to heal 3/5/7 HP, with a condition benefit on Strong.
treat-soft-tissue: Improve a supplied treatment attempt to heal 3/5/7 HP, with a condition benefit on Strong.
turn-the-river: Before defending against a visible adjacent physical attacker, use Reason for this defense and gain 1 Boon. After the attack resolves, move 1 square without provoking. On a Strong defense, also pull the attacker 1 square toward the space you left.
under-their-guard: Choose one adjacent enemy and every other Slowed enemy adjacent to you. Make an Agility melee attack. Each target takes: - On a Standard result, deal 4 physical damage.
undertow-answer: Choose one visible grounded enemy within 4 squares in or beside at least a bucket of water. Choose a visible water square beside the target and make a Reason control attack. On a Standard result, deal 3 physical damage and Slowed 1. Pull 2 squares toward it.
unravel-the-bolt: Self or one visible willing ally within 4 squares, before defending against a single-target spell from a visible caster within 4 squares of you. The recipient gains 2 Boons to the defense. On a Strong defense, after the spell resolves, it may move 1 square without provoking.
urgent-bandaging: Self or one adjacent willing creature. Make a Knowledge roll. Weak — Reduce temporary Bleeding by 2. Standard — Reduce temporary Bleeding by 3. Strong — Reduce temporary Bleeding by 4.
use-a-healing-potion: Spend a Maneuver and use a free hand to give a healing potion to yourself or an adjacent willing creature. An unconscious or restrained recipient counts as willing.
veiled-crossing: Self and one adjacent willing ally along an actual concealed route. You and one adjacent willing ally move up to your Speed along the same concealed route without provoking, ending in separate free supported squares. A Hidden participant remains Hidden while the route conceals it.
wake-the-iron-rune: While wearing armor, while wearing armor, gain Stability 1.
walk-the-thunder: Self along a wall or across water to supported ground. Run up to 4 squares along solid vertical surfaces or across water, ending in a visible free supported ground square. This movement does not provoke.
wear-heavy-armor: While wearing the trained armor, while wearing heavy armor, gain physical resistance 3.
wear-light-armor: While wearing the trained armor, while wearing light armor, gain physical resistance 1.
wear-medium-armor: While wearing the trained armor, while wearing medium armor, gain physical resistance 2.
wear-the-great-beast: Become a mighty bear, elk or great hunting cat for the scene. Gain physical resistance 2, Speed +1 and Stability 2. Equipment folds into the form and supplies its benefits again when you return. To speak, cast spells or use carried items, return to your own shape with a Maneuver. Weak: 5 physical damage. Standard outcome — 6 physical damage. Push 2 squares. Strong outcome — 8 physical damage. Push 3 squares and apply Prone.
weight-of-iron: While wearing armor, while wearing armor, gain Stability 2. When an effect would make you Prone, you may remain standing.
when-the-stars-look-back: Choose one visible enemy within 5 squares. Make a Reason spell attack. You are the source of Frightened. On a Standard result, deal 4 mental damage and Dazed 2.
where-only-eagles-pass: Self and one carried willing or unconscious companion on a natural surface with small holds. Climb up to your Speed along a natural surface with small seams, projections or cracks, carrying one willing or unconscious companion you can physically support. Climbing costs 1 movement per square for this move. End with both of you in separate free supported spaces, or with your companion still carried outside combat.
white-heat: Choose one visible enemy within 6 squares and every other visible Burning enemy within 1 square of it. Choose one visible enemy within 6 squares, plus every other visible Burning enemy within 1 square of it. Make a Knowledge spell attack. On a Standard result, deal 5 fire damage and Burning 2.
wings-over-the-battle: Self to a visible free supported square within 6 squares. Fly up to 6 squares over creatures, gaps and difficult ground to a visible free supported square, then land. This movement does not provoke.
winter-hold: Choose one visible enemy within 5 squares. Make a Knowledge spell attack. On a Standard result, deal 4 cold damage and Freezing 2.
write-the-final-line: Choose one adjacent creature. Make an Agility melee attack. If the target has temporary Dazed, reduce that temporary rating by 1 before rolling and gain 2 Boons to this attack. On a Standard result, deal 6 physical damage.
rime-footholds: Choose up to three connected solid-surface squares within 1 square. Grow handholds on up to three connected solid-surface squares within 1 square. Creatures can climb those squares using ordinary climbing movement. The holds last ten minutes and remain beneath current climbers until those climbers reach another secure hold. You may replace the set once its climbers are secure.
cold-cuirass: Before taking physical damage from one attack, gain physical resistance 2 against the attack.
breath-of-white: Roll Reason to grow a hedge that provides difficult terrain and heavy cover. Sustain it with a Maneuver each turn.
winter-store: Choose one unattended or willingly offered bundle within reach, up to Bulk 1. Preserve the bundle's perishable contents for 24 hours. Time under this spell does not count toward ordinary spoilage. Keep one bundle preserved at a time. A new casting transfers the effect to the new bundle.
shatterguard: Before a shield-blockable defense against an adjacent attacker, gain 2 Boons to the defense. On a Strong defense, after the attack resolves, apply Freezing 1 to the attacker and push it 2 squares away from you.
road-of-rime: Choose up to eight connected supported ground squares within 6 squares. Self and one willing ally within 3 squares. Lay a ribbon of up to eight connected supported ground squares within 6 squares. Entering these squares costs 1 movement, replacing difficult-ground costs, until the end of your next turn. You and one willing ally within 3 squares may each move up to 3 squares along the ribbon without provoking.
still-the-avalanche: Self and willing allies within 3 squares affected by one event that would forcibly move them, before its damage or displacement resolves. Each recipient gains Stability 3 against the forced movement and physical resistance 3 and cold resistance 3 against the triggering damage event. Each may remain standing if that event would make it Prone.
whiteout: Choose one connected area of visible ground squares within 6 squares. Make a Knowledge roll. Place heavy-cover snow in up to 5/8/12 connected ground squares on Weak/Standard/Strong, all within 6 squares. It lasts until the end of your next turn. On later turns, you may spend a Maneuver to sustain it until the end of your next turn.
rim-strike: Choose one adjacent enemy. Make a Brawn shield attack. On a Standard result, deal 3 physical damage. Push 1 square away from you.
shielded-advance: Then one willing ally adjacent to your destination, move up to 2 squares without provoking. Choose one willing ally adjacent to your destination. While you remain adjacent and hold the shield, it gains 1 Boon to its next shield-blockable defense before the end of your next turn.
hook-with-the-shield: Choose one adjacent enemy. Make a Brawn control attack. On a Standard result, push 2 squares away from you.
high-guard: Before a shield-blockable defense, use Shield Block as part of this Reaction, granting 2 Boons to eligible defenses until the start of your next turn.
steel-at-the-wrist: Before a defense roll against an adjacent creature’s melee weapon attack, before the defense roll, use Brawn as your defense attribute and gain 1 Boon to that roll.
ironbound-advance: While wearing armor, move up to 4 squares without provoking. While wearing armor, gain Stability 3 until the end of your next turn.
find-your-footing: While climbing or swimming, move up to 3 squares along a route you can climb or swim, paying 1 movement per square for this move. This movement does not provoke.
catch-the-ledge: Use Knowledge with 1 Boon to defend against a mechanical trap you can reach. A Strong defense jams the mechanism after it resolves.
follow-my-leap: Self and up to three willing allies within 2 squares who hear you. You and up to three willing allies who hear you each jump up to 5 squares from your own positions to separate visible free supported landings, with no approach required. These jumps do not provoke.
catch-them-falling: Choose one willing or unconscious creature within 3 squares when it begins to fall, whose weight you can physically support. Move up to 3 squares along a supported route without provoking to reach the creature. With a free hand, catch and place it in a free supported square adjacent to you, stopping its fall.
draw-the-tether: Self and one of your visible summons within 6 squares. Move up to 3 squares toward your summon without provoking. It gains 1 Boon to its next attack this turn when you command it.
recast-the-footprint: Choose one visible summon of yours within 6 squares. Teleport the summon up to 4 squares to a visible free supported space within 6 squares of you that fits its footprint. It retains its HP, conditions, remaining duration and command history.
doors-for-the-host: Every visible summon of yours within 6 squares. Teleport each of your visible summons within 6 squares up to 4 squares to a visible free supported space within 6 squares of you. Each destination fits the form's footprint. You choose the order. The destinations are separate. Each form retains its HP, conditions, remaining duration and command history.
recall-the-shape: Your summons. Your summons' tethers extend to 10 squares. When one of your visible summons would disappear because its distance from you first exceeds 10 squares, you may spend your Reaction to teleport it to a free supported space adjacent to you that fits its footprint. Preserve its HP, conditions, remaining duration and command history. Remaining forced movement continues from the new positions.
set-the-wedge: Choose one adjacent unattended door, lid or movable obstacle. Prepare the obstacle with your lever and wedges. The next Force roll by you or an ally to open, close or move it gains 2 Boons. Choose the intended task when preparing it.
catch-the-mechanism: Before defending against a visible mechanical trap whose workings you can reach, use Knowledge for this defense and gain 1 Boon. On a Strong defense, after the trap resolves, its mechanism remains jammed until someone spends a Main Action freeing it.
wind-the-sight: Your ranged weapon attacks. Your ranged weapon attacks may use Knowledge in place of their printed attack attribute. Treat cover Banes against those attacks as 1 lower.
snare-the-missile: Before defending against a single-target physical projectile attack, use Knowledge for this defense and gain 2 Boons. On a Strong defense, after the attack resolves, catch the projectile if it fits in your free hand.
breakaway-rig: Roll Fortitude to breathe fire down a line of three squares. Standard and Strong results also inflict Burning.
bank-the-embers: Roll Brawn to strike an adjacent creature with a melee weapon for 2, 3 or 5 physical damage.
cup-the-flame: Before one event deals fire damage, gain fire resistance 3 against the event. Reduce temporary Burning applied to you by that event by 1.
ride-the-furnace-breath: Before one event deals fire damage, gain fire resistance 3 against the event. After it resolves, move up to 4 squares without provoking to a free supported square.
ease-the-spasm: Self or one adjacent willing living creature. Reduce temporary Slowed by 1. The target may move 1 square without provoking.
wake-the-nerves: Choose one adjacent willing living creature. Reduce temporary Dazed by 2 or temporary Paralyzed by 1.
hold-the-pulse: Self or one visible willing living creature within 3 squares, before its end-of-turn Bleeding damage. Reduce temporary Bleeding by 2 before the damage resolves.
cast-off-the-venom: Place a casting point that gives your next Main Action spell this turn 1 Boon and changes where its attack path or area begins.
press-and-bind: Reduce temporary Bleeding by 1 on yourself or an adjacent willing creature.
keep-pressure: Self or one adjacent willing creature before its end-of-turn Bleeding damage. Reduce the target's temporary Bleeding by 1 before the damage resolves.
clear-the-airway: Self or one adjacent willing or unconscious creature, immediately after an inhaled or swallowed substance applies temporary Asleep or Poisoned. Reduce one newly applied temporary Asleep or Poisoned contribution by 2.
call-their-name: Move up to 3 squares without provoking, then let nearby willing allies follow. You and each ally that moves gain 1 Boon to your next defense.
close-shot: Choose one visible enemy immediately after it ends voluntary movement adjacent to you. Make one free Basic Ranged attack against the enemy.
find-the-seam: Choose one visible creature within your ranged weapon attack's range. Your next ranged weapon attack against the target this turn treats its physical resistance and cover Banes as 0.
silent-cue: Choose one visible willing creature within 3 squares. Send a sentence of up to twenty words in a language the target understands. It may immediately send a sentence of up to twenty words back to you.
name-what-is-real: Self or one visible willing ally within 3 squares immediately after temporary Dazed is applied. Reduce the newly applied temporary Dazed contribution by 1.
quiet-conference: Self and up to three visible willing allies within 3 squares. Link the participants for silent conversation for ten minutes. Each can send short spoken-length messages to the group without an action, in languages the listeners understand. A participant beyond 10 squares from you leaves the link until it returns.
thought-before-the-blow: Before defending against an attack you can perceive, use Reason for this defense and gain 1 Boon. After the attack resolves, move up to 2 squares without provoking.
shade-the-eyes: Self or one visible willing ally within 3 squares before one event deals radiant damage. Grant radiant resistance 3 against the triggering event. Reduce temporary Blinded applied by that event by 1.
beacon-through-terror: After a visible attack against you resolves, use a Reaction to teleport up to 3 squares to a visible free supported square.
road-of-dawn: Choose up to three visible willing creatures within 4 squares, including yourself. Each target reduces temporary Frightened by 1 and may move up to 2 squares without provoking to a free supported square.
last-light-of-the-watch: Choose one visible willing ally within 3 squares before a defense roll. Reduce the target's temporary Blinded and Frightened by 1 each before the defense. It gains 2 Boons to that defense.
spot-the-tell: Choose one visible creature within 6 squares whose attack you witnessed this scene. Choose the witnessed attack. Learn its range and defense attribute. You and every ally within 3 squares who hears your explanation gain 1 Boon to the next defense against that attack before the start of your next turn.
clear-the-smoke: Choose up to three connected visible squares within 3 squares containing ordinary smoke or fog. Disperse ordinary smoke or fog in the chosen squares until the end of your next turn.
crosswind: Self or one visible willing ally within 3 squares before defending against a single-target physical projectile attack. The target gains 2 Boons to the defense.
turn-the-fall: Self or one visible willing or unconscious creature within 3 squares immediately before it lands from a fall. Reduce the distance used for this fall's damage by 4 squares. You may shift the landing to a visible free supported square within 1 square of its original location, along an open route.
play-it-off: Before a Guile roll explaining suspicious behavior to a listener who understands you, without violence, describe a plausible explanation. Gain 2 Boons to the Guile roll.
slip-the-closing-door: After a visible enemy ends voluntary movement adjacent to you, move up to 2 squares without provoking. If your endpoint offers actual concealment, you may attempt to Hide there as part of this Reaction.
duck-into-the-brush: While vegetation supplies cover, while vegetation gives you cover, gain 1 Boon to defenses against attacks dealing physical damage.
shield-roof: Self and willing adjacent allies. While you hold the shield, you and willing adjacent allies gain Stability 2 and 2 Boons to defenses against shield-blockable area attacks until the end of your next turn.
field-triage: Choose up to three adjacent willing or unconscious creatures, including yourself. For each target, choose temporary Bleeding, Burning, Freezing or Poisoned and reduce it by 2. You may choose a different condition for each.
stay-with-my-voice: Choose one willing ally within 3 squares who hears you, immediately before it chooses action categories at the start of its turn. Reduce the target's temporary Dazed by 2 before it chooses its action categories.
lend-your-eyes: Self and up to three adjacent willing conscious creatures other than summoned forms. Link your sight with up to three willing conscious creatures for the scene. At the start of each participant's turn, it may choose to see through its own eyes or one linked participant's eyes until the start of its next turn. Use those eyes' vision. The network lasts while you remain conscious. A participant's link ends if it becomes unconscious or moves more than 20 squares from you.
read-the-ward: Choose one visible ongoing magical effect within 6 squares. Learn the effect's remaining duration and any stated way to escape or end it. Choose yourself or one ally within 6 squares who hears you. That creature gains 2 Boons to its next attribute roll to escape or disrupt the effect before the end of your next turn.
catch-the-root: Before forced movement while you can grasp rooted vegetation, gain Stability 3 against the triggering forced movement. If that movement would apply Prone, you remain standing.
the-forest-takes-the-blow: Choose one visible willing ally within 3 squares occupying rooted vegetation, before it defends against an attack dealing physical damage. The ally gains 2 Boons to this defense. After the attack resolves, it may move up to 3 squares without provoking, starting through the vegetation around it.
a-common-tongue: Lead a conversation across language barriers and give participating allies 2 Boons to negotiate a specific agreement.
the-strong-arm: Choose one visible creature within 4 squares. You can throw weapons or improvised items that a normal person would require two hands to throw. Make a Brawn attack. On a Standard result, deal 4 physical damage. The target is pushed 1 square.
the-last-word: When you enter dying, take one Main Action before the Dying procedure. Then resolve Dying normally. Once per scene.
the-impossible-escape: When grappled, make an Agility check. Weak: Reduce your Grappled rating by 2. Standard outcome — Reduce your Grappled rating by 3. Strong outcome — You are free of the Grapple. Your Grappled rating becomes 0. You can squeeze through a gap wide enough for your head and shoulders at half Speed.
a-name-worth-knowing: Work with the DA to introduce a contact and a small favor owed between you. Gain 2 Boons in social interactions with that contact.
the-web-of-whispers: One question about a person, place, faction or event your network or research could plausibly know. Ask one question. The DA answers truthfully from what that network would know. The answer may be incomplete or point to a source. You also learn who can tell you more.
the-lucky-trinket: You carry a personal trinket you believe is magical. It may or may not be. Once a day, when you make a non-combat roll, you can use the trinket to gain 2 Boons on that roll.
the-mountain-walks: Charge in a straight line, pushing creatures out of your path and breaking through nonmagical barriers you can damage.
touched-by-the-divine: You understand every spoken language you hear. Your own speech and literacy remain the languages you have learned.
